name: silicon-sandwiches-modular-deployment
description: Kata Silicon Sandwiches em dois pacotes de deployment (packages/sandwiches e packages/delivery). Esta raiz não é implantada: só junta os scripts de desenvolvimento.

scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/delivery && npm test --prefix packages/sandwiches && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test test/system.test.js
scripts.check:arch: node scripts/check-deployments.js && npm run check:arch --prefix packages/sandwiches
scripts.reset:db: npm run reset:db --prefix packages/sandwiches && npm run reset:db --prefix packages/delivery
